questions.q: What should you write before choosing a model for a MedTech AI tool?
options: The marketing name
The intended use, including what the tool does not do
The final price
The training plan for fine-tuning the model on the client's historic records
questions.why: The intended use decides the risk, testing depth and approval points.

questions.q: Under Part 11, which three things must an electronic signature show?
options: Printed name, date and time, and the meaning of the signature
Email, phone and job title
Model version, prompt and cost
Department, site, manager and the IP address of the computer used to sign
questions.why: Signatures show who signed, when, and what the signature means, such as review or approval.

questions.q: An inspector picks one complaint. What should your audit record let you show?
options: Only the final signed text
Only the model's name
The AI draft, model and prompt versions, inputs, human edits and signature
Only the final signed text, since drafts are temporary working notes and not records
questions.why: For AI, the audit trail must show what the AI produced and what the person changed.

questions.q: Which ALCOA+ principles are most at risk when an AI drafts records?
options: Legible and Enduring, because AI text can be hard to read and may be deleted by the provider
Available and Consistent
Complete and Legible
Attributable and Original
questions.why: The record must show who wrote what, and the source records must stay unchanged.

questions.q: Where should the AI write its draft?
options: Straight into the signed record
Into a clearly marked draft field in the validated QMS
Straight into the signed record, so the coordinator only has to click approve
Into an email to the regulator
questions.why: Only the signed record counts; drafts are kept apart and attributed.

questions.q: The model provider plans to switch the model behind your API name next month. What does your design need?
options: Nothing, newer is better
A plan to retrain users
Pinned versions and change control for any switch
Nothing, newer models are always more accurate so the switch can happen automatically
questions.why: Model or prompt changes are controlled changes to a validated process.
